posts.cooked:
Ameena,

It's a regular board games club. Most of the time we meet on Monday (which I can't make), Tuesday and Wednesday, but the Christmas party bookings really mess up our schedule. It's called London On Board and you can find details on the www.meetup.com website under that name. We play a lot of different board games, but I'm almost always up for a game of Sentinels.

The pub is near St Paul's, not too far away from Bank, Liverpool Street or Moorgate underground, if that helps orient you.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
You know, for some reason I assumed you were in the US, PWatson…I think it was just 'cause of the paying-for-my-shipping thing, I just assumed everyone doing so was over there in America, lol.

Anyway, atm I'm working five days a week 'cause it's nearly Christmas, but once that's died down (usually around January-February), I go back to my normal hours and so have Mondays and Thursdays off (whatever the case, though, I never work weekends). I've been looking for a new job for months now (for various reasons, one of the main ones is that the train fares are so expensive I'm using nearly half my wages just to get to work :P). Travelling to London, I can get trains terminating at Victoria or at Charing Cross (the former is faster, the latter stops as Waterloo East as its penultimate stop so usually I get off there). If it looks like I might actually be available for a session at some point then I'll look into it and see which Tube station is nearest.

Maybe me and my boyfriend can come along some time. We have some other card games too - Ascension, Chrononauts, and Braggart. And another one, Forbidden Island, which isn't a card game but has cards in it, and is only sort of a board game 'cause the "board" consists of loads of small square tiles placed together.

Anyway…atm I'm busy on weekdays due to work, but if can I manage to get a new job then of course I don't know when I'll be available then either, lol.
